data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 claims the §11.3 criterion is 'vacuously satisfied by any critic that crashes,' which asserts a substantive fact about the ritual's semantics. But SRC_001 provides no evidence or block reference to substantiate that §11.3 actually treats crashes as a vacuous pass rather than, e.g., a disqualifying failure or an explicit exception. Without evidence that §11.3 contains the stated rule, the argument rests on an unsupported premise and cannot be adjudicated as a valid fault.
